1.web: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
1.asv: Why do the nations rage, And the peoples meditate a vain thing?

2.web: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against Yahweh, and against his Anointed, saying,
2.asv: The kings of the earth set themselves, And the rulers take counsel together, Against Jehovah, and against his anointed, saying,

3.web: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”
3.asv: Let us break their bonds asunder, And cast away their cords from us.

4.web: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.
4.asv: He that sitteth in the heavens will laugh: The Lord will have them in derision.

5.web: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:
5.asv: Then will he speak unto them in his wrath, And vex them in his sore displeasure:

6.web: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”
6.asv: Yet I have set my king Upon my holy hill of Zion.

7.web: I will tell of the decree. Yahweh said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.
7.asv: I will tell of the decree: Jehovah said unto me, Thou art my son; This day have I begotten thee.

8.web: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.
8.asv: Ask of me, and I will givetheethe nations for thine inheritance, And the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

9.web: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”
9.asv: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; Thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

10.web: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.
10.asv: Now therefore be wise, O ye kings: Be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

11.web: Serve Yahweh with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
11.asv: Serve Jehovah with fear, And rejoice with trembling.

12.web: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.
12.asv: Kiss the son, lest he be angry, and ye perish in the way, For his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all they that take refuge in him.
